description: Department of Biosciences and Bioengineering  IIT Roorkee. # Inivitation to the 48th National Seminar on Crystallography. On the auspicious occasion of the 175th Anniversary of the Indian Institute of Technology, Roorkee Department of Biosciences and Bioengineering is organising the 48th National Seminar on Crystallography in association with the Indian Crystallographic Association to be held from 25th to 27th November 2021. Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee is the successor of University of Roorkee and thus it is the oldest technical institution of the country established as the Roorkee College of Engineering in 1847 and rechristened as Thomason College of Civil Engineering in 1857. In the year 2001, University of Roorkee was declared as the Institute of national importance and converted into Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IITR) on September 21, 2001. The Department of Mechanical Engineering came into being in the year 1946 and the first batch of Mechanical Engineers was graduated in the year 1949.
